The fundamentals of statistics, probability, and econometrics. Each course is divided into chapters: slides available online, downloadable as PDFs, and—coming soon—interactive demonstrations and exercises.

## Courses

- [**Descriptive Statistics**](cours/statistique-descriptive/index.qmd)
— summarizing and visualizing data.
- [**Probability**](cours/probabilites/index.qmd)
— the language of chance.
- [**Inferential Statistics**](cours/statistique-inferentielle/index.qmd)
— from sample to population.
- [**Introduction to Econometrics**](cours/econometrie-introduction/index.qmd)
— regression as a tool.
- **Data Analysis** — multivariate methods. *(coming soon)*
- **Mathematical Analysis** — limits, derivatives, integrals. *(coming soon)*
- **Linear Algebra** — vectors, matrices, linear transformations. *(coming soon)*
